task.goal: Replace the breaker panel in my garage

plan.title: Replace garage breaker panel - arrange professional
plan.summary: Replacing a garage breaker panel requires a licensed electrician. Observe safely, document, and arrange professional replacement without opening or working on the panel.
plan.professionalReason: Replacing a breaker panel involves main electrical panel and live mains wiring which can cause fatal shock, arc flash, and fire if handled without license and utility disconnect. Have a licensed electrician perform the replacement.
plan.sourceNote: AI-written plan · check your owner's manual

steps.title: Observe panel from safe distance
steps.instruction: Stand back and look at the garage breaker panel without opening it. Note any burning smell, buzzing, heat, scorch marks, or tripped breakers from a safe distance.

cautions.text: Do not touch breakers beyond normal use and do not open the panel cover. Keep hands and objects away.

stopIf: you smell burning or see smoke or scorch marks
you hear buzzing or see sparks

steps.title: Document panel for electrician
steps.instruction: From outside the closed panel, photograph the panel door, any labels with amperage and circuits, and the area around it for the electrician to review.

cautions.text: Do not remove panel cover or touch exposed wiring to take photos.

stopIf: the panel is hot or damaged and unsafe to stay near

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Photos show closed panel, labels, and surrounding area clearly

steps.title: Check access and environment
steps.instruction: Look at access to the panel. Note if storage blocks it and plan to have it cleared before the professional visit. Do not unmount anything.

cautions.text: Keep water away from electrical equipment. Do not move heavy storage alone.

stopIf: water is leaking onto the panel area

steps.title: List reasons and home details
steps.instruction: Write down why you want replacement, such as age, tripping, rust, or adding circuits, and your home age and size to tell the electrician.

steps.title: Arrange licensed electrician replacement
steps.instruction: Contact a licensed electrician. Have the electrician obtain permits, coordinate utility disconnect, replace the panel, and test and label the new panel.
